owner_directive: Exclude Splenic Authority as a scored personality predictor in all NEW Human Design matching model versions. Preserve original calculations, doctrine and historical scores for audit and comparability. Audit similar constructs by comparable evidentiary standards.
model_boundary: FORWARD_ONLY_NEW_PERSONALITY_SCORER; legacy frozen source models and old numerical receipts must remain unchanged, and this policy does not itself rewrite a live scoring runtime.

excluded.reason: No operationally established human prevalence, reliability, signal onset/duration, event definition, base-rate comparison, calibrated accuracy or shown independence from common intuition/anxiety. Infallibility language is not an empirically supportable user-scored trait.
excluded.reentry_gate: Independent, preregistered comparative evidence showing a reproducible, source-precise frequency/accuracy difference over validated non-HD baselines, with a stable positive and negative signal/outcome definition.

symmetry.reason: Other authorities have the same risks of ambiguity, alternative ordinary explanations and missing between-group comparisons. Removing Splenic alone must not mechanically reward Self-Projected or Emotional candidates.

other_source_qualifications.reason: Should not evade the Splenic exclusion through a hanging Gate or overlapping statement.
Retrospective tailoring and a result-proof 'something always happens' prediction cannot improve ranks.
Source explicitly frames profile as contemplative not conventional empirical profiling.

criteria_for_new_score: Mechanically calculate chart feature in a fixed source school and birth-time convention
Write a specific observable behavior including subject, reference class, frequency/context and possible disconfirming case
Freeze full conditions and exceptions from source BEFORE seeing participant answer or natal rank
Predefine outcome and plausible non-astrological rivals, baselines and null
Collect enough blind, independently sourced participant cases to estimate predictive advantage above baseline and calibration
Cap dependencies and correlated repeated claims, preserve missing information as unknown
Publish negative and null outcomes, do not select method because it improves exposed owner birth rank
required_test_gate: Any proposed new model scored mapping with source id from excluded list or chart feature authority Splenic is rejected; scores cannot silently reuse a historical mapping. This checker is not yet a live model integration.
